notes: Blocks you build with the Building Book no longer earn Skills XP, Guilds reputation or Daily Quest progress when broken, and towns leave them alone.
Land Claims pop back out pistons and slime or honey blocks placed beside someone else's claim, and break pistons that move blocks into or out of one afterwards (the move is not undone).
Town Projects no longer duplicate lecterns, barrels or smokers when a spot is removed or rebuilt, and a Treasure Map cairn's lantern no longer drops as a free item.
Many packs now recognize dead bushes, lily pads, item frames, note blocks and rooted dirt, so the Minimap draws them properly.
A creative player no longer gives party mates Defeat progress, Wanderers state real distances, and choosing an ordinary moon before a full moon sticks.
Only the server console or an operator can make a pack forget its saved data, and the Server size setup is saved as done only when every setting was applied.
Goals, Journal, Quests, Nicknames, Stash, Storm, Zones and the Saga story packs save and clean up more safely.

admin_bp.notes: Server size waits a fixed 5 seconds for every setting and is saved as done only when all were applied; the setup checklist waits once more for long answers; the diagnostics screen is tidier. Diagnostics: only the server console or an operator player can send the forget request, and wrapped callbacks are tracked per event signal.
